S.FORM: alang R'uyan ga niya mki sku Sincik Keng atu Gpho go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 92 buwan, 237 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 89% kyan ku 212 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 11% kyan ku 25 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 82%, Amis 4%, Bunun 2%, saySiyat 1%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na R'uyan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na R'uyan hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na R'uyan hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na R'uyan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'llaw na R'uyan hya' ga Heku'. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ rʔujan ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku [s|ɕ]in[ʦ|ʨ]ik keŋ atu ɣpħo ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** ami[s|ɕ] * βunun * [s|ɕ]aj[s|ɕ]ijat * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na rʔujan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na rʔujan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na rʔujan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na rʔujan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔllaw na rʔujan ħjaʔ ɣa ħekuʔ reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
